verdict.rationale: Kong AI Gateway documents usage analytics, OpenTelemetry metrics, audit logs, and cost tracking, but nothing shows the product generating AI insights or suggestions from a user's data inside the product. The semantic-similarity mention of 'anomaly detection' describes LLM workflows a developer could build on top of the gateway, not a built-in insights feature. Proxying AI traffic to model providers is a different capability from in-product AI insights.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
